<a id="summary"></a>

## Summary

Public core contracts, real source inspection/provider seams and SDK query/discovery semantics are implemented and exercised with supplied/native synthetic evidence; this does not yet claim installed CLI composition. Core/adapter/loader/SDK edge cases plus a throwaway external SDK discovery smoke; full installed CLI/recipe acceptance is phase3. Output/docs can be authored concurrently in guide wave1; phase gates are outcome checkpoints, not a reason to serialize independent source work.
